changes.from: AeroSense is a portable, cartridge-based reader that exposes a sample's gas to engineered live-cell wells and reads their fluorescence. changes.from: Our patent attorney advised that our own early disclosure can later count against novelty, so we are holding back some technical detail until a filing is made. This sits uneasily with iGEM's open-science norms and with our wish to leave reusable work for future teams. We resolve it by sequencing — file first, then publish — and by keeping our education materials fully open, because they do not depend on that detail.
changes.to: Our patent consultation identified disclosure timing as a strategic consideration. The team’s current decision is to publish the technical detail, consistent with the open-science contribution described on Entrepreneurship. Potential protection and commercial licensing remain subjects for university and professional review. Education resources are openly shared.
